entries.zh: 悲痛平息，凉其心火；怒气、哀伤消解
entries.en: for the grief/pain to subside; to cool one's heart-fire (anger or sorrow abating)
for an illness to abate; to recover, be cured (q. melhorar)

entries.zh: 平息，安抚；汉字作「聰」，与西义不合
entries.notes: 闽南栏 T99 污损，且汉字「聰」（聪）与 Aplacar（平息）语义不合，疑有误字

entries.zh: 修善，致力于德行；追随、效仿、注重德性
entries.en: to apply oneself to virtue; to follow, imitate, attend to virtue (q. seguir, ymitar, mirar tud.)
wretched, stingy, miserly (apocado q. miserable, mezquinos)

entries.zh: 悭悋，吝啬；第二字原件标疑（悸/悋）
entries.notes: 第二汉字封存件标 [疑:悸/悋]，取悋（吝）义

entries.zh: 胆怯畏缩、惶恐说不出话；汉字作「有尻」，音义不合
entries.notes: 汉字「尻」与西义明显不合，疑为误读字；闽南栏无调号记录

entries.zh: 心乱，心绪烦闷（寸心不宁）
entries.en: with a troubled, anxious heart (coracon congoxado)

entries.zh: 心急，气量窄（心里容不下屋宇——气小而急躁）
entries.en: impatient, of a small heart (as if the houses could not fit in his heart)

entries.zh: 培土，壅根（农事：给作物根部培土）

entries.en: to earth up and tend trees; cultivate

entries.zh: 湾船：船入湾靠港；又泊船（ô chūn）
entries.en: for the ship to come to port/harbor; to moor a ship (vt ô chūn)

entries.zh: 留宿安顿；汉字作「迷」且两音栏不合，存疑
entries.notes: 汉字「迷」（mî/mūi）与 R 栏 mŷ、M 栏 se 均不合，四栏无法互证

entries.en: to settle oneself, take up residence
the top of a building; the upper story

entries.notes: 闽南栏 [涂删不清]（T99），凭汉字「樓閣」与 R 栏判定

entries.zh: 闺，闺房（女子幽居的内室；Aposentada 指已安置内室之妇人）
entries.en: the women's inner chamber (for women secluded at home)

entries.notes: 西栏 [残]、汉/闽南栏 [空]，仅余 R 栏 vay.，无从释义
